items.q: How much does a visit cost?
items.a: The speech therapy consultation (first visit) with a therapy plan and recommendations costs PLN 150 and lasts 60 minutes. A follow-up therapy visit costs PLN 80 (30 min) or PLN 120 (45 min).

items.q: Where and when does she see patients?
items.a: The practice is located at Biernota 11, 44-230 Czerwionka-Leszczyny, Poland. Sessions are held on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 7:30 am–7:00 pm.

items.q: In which languages does she provide consultations?

items.a: I welcome children from the age of 2. Every child develops at their own pace, so I do not use a single approach for everyone – I look for the methods and activities that best suit each child. Conversation, play, relationship and an individual approach are an important part of my therapy.

items.q: What areas do I specialise in?
items.a: I specialise in the diagnosis and speech therapy of children from the age of 2, with particular focus on: speech and communication development, delayed speech development, speech disorders and articulation difficulties, myofunctional and orthodontic therapy, supporting the communication development of children on the autism spectrum, aphasia and language disorders, and the correct function of the articulation organs, breathing and swallowing. In my work I focus on an individual approach, a relationship with the child, and therapy through play and activities suited to the child's needs and interests.

I completed a master's degree in early childhood and preschool education, as well as postgraduate studies in speech therapy. I am currently continuing my education with postgraduate studies in autism, through which I am developing my skills and expanding the knowledge needed to work with children on the autism spectrum and children with diverse developmental needs. I continuously invest in my qualifications, because I believe a good speech therapist should never stop learning, developing and looking for the best ways to support a child.

items.q: How do I book a visit?
items.a: Call +48 518 542 193, write using the contact form on this page, or use the practice's profile on Medfile.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Speech and language therapy for children and adults in five areas. We start with a consultation, then agree on a therapy plan.

areas.title: Speech therapy consultation and therapy
areas.text: Individual sessions tailored to the child's needs, age and abilities. During sessions I support the development of speech, communication and correct pronunciation.

areas.title: Therapy for speech disorders and defects
areas.text: Therapy for articulation difficulties and incorrect production of speech sounds. I work on preparing the speech organs, eliciting the correct sound, reinforcing it, and using it in everyday communication.

areas.title: Therapy for delayed speech development and aphasia
areas.text: Support for children with difficulties in speech and language development. Therapy includes, among others, developing comprehension, vocabulary, building statements and communicating with others.

areas.title: Therapy for children on the autism spectrum
areas.text: Individually tailored sessions supporting the development of communication, speech comprehension, establishing contact and building statements. In therapy I take into account the needs, abilities and way each child functions.

areas.title: Myofunctional and orthodontic therapy
areas.text: Therapy supporting the correct function of the tongue, lips and other speech organ structures. Depending on the need, it covers the resting tongue position, breathing, swallowing and functions essential for the correct development of the speech apparatus.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: First visit (up to 60 min): diagnosis, interview with the parent, drawing up an individual therapy plan, and recommendations for work at home.

steps.title: Therapy
steps.text: Follow-up visits last 45 min or 30 min.
